**Checks** (see CONTRIBUTING.md):
- [ ] `node --test test/*.test.js` passes
- [ ] `node scripts/gen-docs.js --check` passes (run `node scripts/gen-docs.js` if not)
- [ ] New commands and flags have help (`askai help <command>`), new plugins have `askai plugins info` and tests
- [ ] Nothing adds text to every prompt, and nothing overwrites a setting someone already set
